label: Khawagi review: Review overlapping regular antipsychotics in an adult when the overlap lasts more than two continuous calendar months
title: Review overlapping regular antipsychotics in an adult when the overlap lasts more than two continuous calendar months
statement: Review two different regular antipsychotics taken together by an adult for more than two continuous calendar months, except planned clozapine augmentation with a current specialist review plan.

plain_summary: Review two different regular antipsychotics taken together by an adult for more than two continuous calendar months, except planned clozapine augmentation with a current specialist review plan. The clozapine exception is an Australian screening convention.

medicine_groups.name: Regularly scheduled antipsychotics
medicine_groups.note: Count each distinct ingredient once. Use supply dates, directions and quantities to establish continuous overlapping cover. For depots, use the documented dosing interval. Exclude completed switches, brief as-needed use and brief antiemetic or procedural courses.

rule_for_models: Review two distinct regular antipsychotics in an adult aged 18 or older when they overlap for more than two continuous calendar months. Cite both medicines. Exclude completed switches without qualifying overlap and brief as-needed or antiemetic courses. Another indication alone does not exclude regular co-use. For a clozapine pair, cite specialist confirmation that the combination was unplanned or has no current review plan. Exclude that pair if the specialist planned it and has a current review plan. An unknown assessment leaves the finding possible. If age or continuity is unclear but could qualify, keep the finding possible and ask about age, regular doses, injection dates, supplies elsewhere and any switch. Do not bridge a confirmed gap.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review the ongoing need for both regularly scheduled antipsychotics and, if clozapine is involved, confirm the specialist's augmentation plan and next review?

needs_facts.what: Specialist assessment of clozapine augmentation and review plan
needs_facts.meets: Only for qualifying overlap involving clozapine. An applicable specialist assessment that explicitly rules out planned augmentation or confirms the lack of a current review plan supports a finding. A documented augmentation plan with current specialist review resolves it. An unknown plan supports only a question about the missing assessment.

options.words: The specialist planned this combination and has a current review plan
The specialist confirms this combination was unplanned
The specialist confirms there is no current review plan for this combination
